speaker: thabo_mokoena
headline: DELAY DOES NOT STAND STILL. IT COMPOUNDS.
deck: A missed payment or interrupted service becomes more expensive over time because households must bridge the gap with debt, unpaid care and lost income.
quote: Continuity matters because every day of delay adds another layer to the burden carried below the institution.
facts: Short delays can trigger transport and borrowing costs.
Long delays eat into food, rent and care budgets.
Risk rises fastest where household buffers are already thin.
Repair must stop the accumulation, not only acknowledge it.

pressure_steps.label: DAY 1
pressure_steps.value: A service or payment is missed.

pressure_steps.label: WEEK 1
pressure_steps.value: Households bridge the gap with time and cash.

pressure_steps.label: MONTH 1
pressure_steps.value: Debt, arrears and lost work begin to compound.

pressure_steps.label: CONTINUED
pressure_steps.value: The administrative delay becomes material damage.

takeaway: Continuity is a class issue because interruption is most expensive for the people with the least buffer.
